THE CALLER IS REPORTING AN AQUEOUS AMMONIA RELEASE AT THE FACILITY DUE TO A LOSS OF POWER. THE POWER OUTAGE CAUSED THE FACILITY TO SHUT DOWN. A MANUAL DRAIN VALVE ON A UNIT WAS CLOSED DURING SHUT DOWN, AND WAS NOT RE-OPENED FOR STARTUP. THE HUMAN ERROR OF NOT RE-OPENING THE VALVE CAUSED THE AQUEOUS AMMONIA SOLUTION TO FLOW ONTO THE ROOFTOP AND OVER INTO A STORM DRAIN THAT LEADS TO THE SUSQUEHANNA RIVER. THE VALVE WAS OPENED AND REDIRECTED TO THE FACILITY WASTE WATER TREATMENT. THE SOLUTION THAT WENT ELSEWHERE WAS SPRAYED WITH WATER HOSES AND DIRECTED INTO CHEMICAL DRAINS OR TO THE WASTE WATER TREATMENT.

ILLINOIS RIVER AT FACILITY LOCATION IS IN FLOOD STAGE. FACILITY HAS BEEN IDLED/SHUT DOWN, HAS NO POWER, AND IS BEING EVACUATED AT APPROXIMATLEY 2100 HOURS ON 4/18/13. THIS REPORT IS BEING SUBMITTED OUT OF AN ABUNDFANCE OF CAUTION AS THERE EXISTS THE LIKELIHOOD OF MINOR RELEASES AS A RESULT OF THE FLOOD. SPECIFICALLY, THE FLOOD WILL OVERWHELM THE STORMWATER COLLECTION POND AT THE FACILITY. DURING NORMAL OPERATION, THE POND PROVIDES SEPARATION/COLLECTOIN OF FLOATING SHEEN AND FLOATING EXPANDABLE POLYSTYRENE BEADS. WITH THE FLOOD WATER OVERWHELMING THE POND, IT IS EXPECTED THAT SHEEN AND EPS BEADS WILL NOT BE COLLECTED. ADDITIONALLY, A RECENT SPILL (NON REPORTABLE) OF STYRENE WAS NEARLY COMPLETELY MITIGATED, BUT OUT OF ABUNDANCE OF CAUTION FHR IS REPORTING THE POSSIBILITY THAT THIS MAY ALSO CAUSE A SHEEN ON THE FLOOD WATERS.

properties.summary: Incident Type: STORAGE TANK - NRC Report ID: 844773 - Medium Affected: LAND - Suspected Responsible Party: USAF, ROBINS AFB
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 844773
Incident Time: 2007-08-07 19:30:00
Nearest City: Warner Robins, GA
Incident Type: STORAGE TANK
Material: OIL: DIESEL
Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party: USAF, ROBINS AFB
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 7 gallons
INCIDENT DESCRIPTION TAKEN FROM A WEB REPORT////////FUEL LINE LEAK INSIDE CONCRETE TRENCH - BETWEEN A CONVAULT DIESEL FUEL AST AND AN INDOOR EMERGENCY GENERATOR. SMELL OF FUEL IN AREA BY PASSERSBY RESULTED IN OUR LOCAL RESPONSE. OBSERVATIONS INDICATE THAT SMALL AMOUNT OF FUEL LEAKED INTO CONCRETE TRENCH ONLY WHILE EMERGENCY GENERATOR WAS ACTIVELY RUNNING. GENERATOR OPERATED MOST RECENTLY ON FRIDAY, 3 AUG 07. LEAK MAY HAVE OCCURRED OVER AN UNDETERMINED AMOUNT OF TIME. RAIN EVENTS MAY HAVE OVERFLOWED THE TRENCH CAUSING SMALL AMOUNTS OF FUEL TO ENTER ADJACENT STORM CONVEYANCE DROP INLET. SMALL AMOUNTS OF FUEL WERE FOUND AT THE NEXT 4 DOWNSTREAM STORM DROP INLETS, BUT WERE NOT FOUND AT ANY OF THE DOWNSTREAM PIPE OUTFALLS, WETLANDS AREA, OR AT MOST DISTANT POINT AT PROPERTY BOUNDARY. STANDING WATER AT DOWNSTREAM LOCATIONS DID NOT HAVE A SHEEN.
